blocks.content: Course: Build your First Web App with React
On the left side of the coding area, you'll see the Explorer — a file tree that lists everything in your project:
Click any file in the Explorer to open it in the editor.
For most lessons, you'll only work inside src/App.jsx. That's where your React component code lives; the other files keep the project running in the background.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
